title: orthocarpus copelandii var. typicus
intro: Orthocarpus copelandii var. typicus, commonly known as Western Stickseed, is a flowering plant native to western North America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Orthocarpus copelandii var. typicus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
